app.title: Salef Al-Awaleen

app.phaseNotice: The characters' voices and words are AI-generated and may be wrong. Your voice is sent to Google Gemini during the session only and is not stored by us.
xr.unsupported: This device does not support WebXR. You can view the 3D majlis here.
xr.mrUnavailable: Mixed reality is not available on this device.
xr.placeHint: Point at the floor and press the trigger to place the character
xr.placedManual: Floor not detected; the character was placed in front of you.
states.title: Character state preview (not an AI conversation)
touch.hint: Drag to look around, pinch to zoom
env.label: Place
talk.hint: Tap “Start talking”, allow the microphone, then just speak. You can interrupt any time.
talk.xrHint: Start talking before entering the headset view so the microphone prompt can appear.
err.mic_denied: Microphone permission was not granted. Enable it in the browser settings and try again.
err.mic_unavailable: No working microphone was found on this device.
err.invalid_code: Wrong access code. Enter it under “Options”.
err.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
err.server_not_configured: The voice server is running but the Gemini key has not been added yet.
err.server_unreachable: Could not reach the voice server. Check the internet connection.
err.upstream: Could not connect to Gemini. The free daily limit may be used up.
err.connection_lost: The connection was lost. Tap “Start talking” again.
voice.notConfigured: Voice conversation is not enabled yet: the voice server has not been set up.
interrupt.auto: Automatic: talk over him and he stops
interrupt.tap: By button: if he keeps interrupting himself
companion.hint: Walk slowly in an open space; the headset may not know where walls and furniture are.
settings.voiceNote: The voice changes from the next session.
tone.on: On (elder deeper, Nawwara childlike, Jelo alien)
room.none: No room data. Run Space Setup on the headset or press “Scan room”.
char.nawwara: Nawwara — fairy of the Oasis of Colours
kids.notice: {name} is for children with adult supervision. The child's voice is sent to Google Gemini (the free tier may use data to improve its services), so don't share personal information.
